title: When the Market Decides: The Creeping Governance Crisis of Critical Infrastructure in Norway’s Datacentre Politics
summary_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) transforms industries, offering unparalleled opportunities alongside complex challenges. From healthcare to finance to democracy, AI enhances efficiency, scale, and innovation. But ethical concerns persist around regulation, privacy and bias.
title_cn: When the Market Decides: The Creeping Governance Crisis of Critical Infrastructure in Norway’s Datacentre Politics
